title: Crunchyroll to Stream Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Anime Starting on October 11
content: Crunchyroll announced on Monday that it will simultaneously stream the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus television anime series in Japanese with English subtitles on October 11 in the United States, Canada, Latin America including Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Europe.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Just Removed Fan-Favorite Anime Series & You Can’t Stream It Anywhere Else
content: A fan-favorite anime series has just been removed from Crunchyroll, and now fans can’t find it streaming anywhere else after this latest update. Crunchyroll is one of the biggest anime streaming platforms out there as they just launched a new wave of releases as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule .

title: Naruto’s Live-Action Movie Has Way Bigger Plans Than You Think
content: A new report is teasing that if the new Naruto live-action movie ends up being a success, there could be way more movies planned than any fan could have ever expected. Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto recently celebrated its 20th anniversary, and with it has made a return with all kinds of new projects.

title: The Record of a Fallen Vampire Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content: A website opened on Monday to announce the television anime adaptation of Kyo Shirodaira and Yuri Kimura 's The Record of a Fallen Vampire ( Vampire Jūjikai ) manga, which will debut in 2027. The website also revealed the anime's teaser promotional video, teaser visual, and main cast and staff members.
author: ANN

title: Manga 'Vampire Juujikai' Gets TV Anime For 2027
content: Production company Pony Canyon opened an official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyou Shirodaira 's Vampire Juujikai ( The Record of a Fallen Vampire ) on Monday revealing the main cast pair, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promo. The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.
